candidates.name: Fayetteville Lateral
aka: Texas Gas Fayetteville/Greenville Expansion - Fayetteville Lateral

evidence.note: FERC draft EIS notice CP07-417: Fayetteville Lateral 166.2 mi of 36-inch pipe in AR and Coahoma County MS; Phase I first 66 mi Conway to White County, Phase II remaining 100 mi

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for Texas Gas Fayetteville Lateral (P0189 is the separate Fayetteville Express; P0263 is the main line). About 267 km, in service 2008-2009. The Greenville Lateral (96.4 mi, MS) is a sibling and may need its own check; found_regulators already notes CP07-417. Phase 3 (CP08-467, AR, length blank in EIA) looks like a capacity add on the same lateral; length unknown.

candidates.name: Viola Project (Line UA)
candidates.to: Evergy Viola power plant, Sumner County, KS

evidence.note: 19.33 mi of new 16-inch Line UA, Wellington compressor station, FERC docket CP26-74, application filed 2026-01-21; up to 116,296 Dth/d

candidates.why_maybe_new: 19.33 mi is about 31 km, above the floor. No roster row; P7826 is a different Southern Star compressor project.

candidates.name: We Energies Ixonia Lateral
aka: Wisconsin Gas Ixonia to Brookfield and Germantown lateral
candidates.from: Guardian Pipeline terminus near Ixonia, Jefferson County, WI

evidence.note: 35-mile lateral to take Guardian gas, built 2003
engineering firm project page for the Ixonia to Brookfield and Germantown lateral

candidates.why_maybe_new: About 35 mi (56 km) of 30, 24 and 16-inch pipe, in service 2003. Roster has Guardian (P0195, to Ixonia) but no We Energies lateral. Utility-owned transmission lateral rather than a distribution grid.
